title: Mapping the Phenotypic Landscape of Beta-lactam Resistance in Streptococcus pneumoniae
description: Code, analysis workflows and manuscript source data for the paper Mapping the Phenotypic Landscape of Beta-lactam Resistance in Streptococcus pneumoniae, which introduces Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) Cartography — a multidimensional-scaling and multivariate linear mixed model framework for analysing continuous, correlated minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) profiles.
